specs.title: sign-in page: Arabic RTL by default, provisional wordmark, dev form in dev mode
shell: navigation, language persistence and My Work (Transformation Office)
create a modular transformation with an entry phase
list: sort, filter chips, column selection and pagination controls
edit: a concurrent change gives a 409 conflict with compare and re-apply
archive with a mandatory reason makes the record read-only
administration screens (access + technical administrator)
a user without roles sees no Administration and no business records
a business-unit Lead creates a record: Edit/Archive and the audit trail appear without a reload (F-DG1-210), the derived grant localized (F-DG1-008)
setup: a fresh End-to-End transformation for the blank-text checks
Charter create: a whitespace Case for change is an inline error and creates no charter
Charter edit: a whitespace Out of scope is an inline error, writes no version and keeps the value
T01: a whitespace Current state is an inline error and sends nothing
Gate G1 submission: a whitespace note is an inline error and submits nothing; visible text is verbatim
Gate G1 decision: a whitespace rationale is an inline error and decides nothing
Journey steps: a whitespace actor is an inline error and writes no journey version
Reason dialog: an invisible-only archive reason is an inline error and archives nothing
Charter create: a form-level validation problem (invalid UTF-8 body) is said once, in one live region
lead creates an End-to-End transformation; the workspace tabs lead to the P2 screens
Diagnose: six T01 dimensions with Unknown; value pools labelled Unquantified with a partial total
Charter: create, save a second version, compare versions; the 3-5 top-outcomes warning
Define: North Star, the good outcome test with reasons, and a required T02 target date
Design: ten canvas boxes, the per-dimension view; workshop mode converts an unresolved item into T04
Evidence: note, filename reference and file upload; a link; review by another person
Gates: G1 shows unverified evidence and offers no submission while incomplete; once complete it is submitted
Gates: the approver's decision — 409 when the submission was superseded, then approval with a rationale
Define → G2: activate a KPI, pass the good outcome test, add a guardrail, compose the thesis; G2 is decided
Design → G3: the target state is complete and G3 is decided by the Sponsor
Team: the six governance roles with their B0018 accountability; the lead assigns a Workstream Lead
read-only auditor (AUD): every P2 screen without write controls; Unknown and Unquantified rendered
setup: a synthetic transformation, an initiative, and a synthetic Finance grant on it
lead: transformation case with sections, one-class lines and gross / cost / net apart; initiative roll-up
Finance validates the baseline (business approval); the lead's later baseline edit makes it Stale; 409 conflict
T09: illustrative B0087 examples (100000 / 500000 SAR per year), live builder, new version, preview lineage
Finance validates formula version 2 (business approval, not its author)
read-only auditor: the four screens with no enabled write control, axe-clean
setup: a G4-ready portfolio of two selected initiatives (synthetic, through the real API)
TL submits G4 after both workstream leads were cleared: two translated 'Owners' items, one per initiative
setup: a Modular transformation whose G1 has an accepted inherited approval (synthetic, real API)

5a. capacity: the owner records a role and capacity; the lead's demand above it is flagged; the owner raises capacity and commits
5b. funding: Finance records an approved funding decision (business approval); A shows Funded
1d. sequencing (End-to-End): launching the funded A before G2/G3 is refused; after G2 and G3 it launches
6a. G4: the lead's submission is refused listing 'Owners', 'Finance validation' and the initiative (translated)
6b. G4: the lead restores the owner, Finance re-validates the case, the lead resubmits; 403 for a non-approver and the submitter
